integrity: The all-dimensional claim is proved combinatorially from the published cyclic boundary model and independently checked by exact finite computations in dimensions \(3\) through \(7\). The finite computation is corroboration, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is restricted to codimension-one homology over \(\mathbf F_2\) for Kühnel’s \(K^d_{2d+3}\), with \(d\ge3\). It does not classify larger supports, integral representatives, or the \(2d+4\)-vertex families. The 1986 original was verified bibliographically but not inspected in full text.
title: Minimum-support codimension-one homology in Kühnel’s \(2d+3\)-vertex sphere-bundle family
